name: Loop kit
description: A family of MIDI loops in one genre, made to be arranged: the genre researched, a kit plan you approve, every loop written, checked to repeat cleanly and captured on its own channels. You get every loop as MIDI (each part alone and all together), a sketch of each, and a cue sheet with your DAW's import steps.

intake.label: Genre
intake.help: As specific as you like: "UK garage", "boom bap with jazz chords", "dark trap".

intake.label: The feel
intake.help: What the kit is for and how it should feel: "late-night, warm, for a beat tape".

intake.label: Parts
intake.help: e.g. "drums, bass, keys, lead". The studio picks the rest from the genre.

intake.label: Anything fixed
intake.help: A tempo, a key, a meter or a name for the kit.

intake.label: References
intake.help: Tracks or producers to study (never copied).

steps.name: Genre
steps.describe: The genre researched from 5+ sources: its tempo, lineup, beat grids, harmony, and the elements that make it unforgettable.

steps.name: Kit plan
steps.describe: The kit in words, before any note: tempo, key, the parts on their channels, and every loop with what it does and how it relates to the others.

steps.name: Loops and MIDI
steps.describe: Every loop written in Strudel, checked (harmony lock, clean loop points, the kit's curve) and captured: each loop as its own clip, every part alone and together.

steps.name: Sketch
steps.describe: Sketch sounds for every channel, auditioned, and a render of the whole kit with stems.

steps.name: Your loops
steps.describe: You look and listen: the kit as a piano roll, the sketch, the cue sheet, and every loop as MIDI to download.

checks.title: The genre is researched, not guessed
checks.how: node .claude/skills/music/strudel.mjs genre passes: every field of the profile, 5+ different sources actually read, 5+ unforgettable elements with at least one for the hook and one for the beat, each with a concrete how.

checks.title: The kit plan holds together
checks.how: node .claude/skills/music/strudel.mjs plan passes with "loops": true and "length_fixed": true: one section per loop, as many loops as the brief asked, each the asked length (1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 bars), every part on its own channel, the genre signature carried by named loops; and it follows the flow (flow/flow.json): "flow" set, the intensities on its curve and rules, its techniques planned (each with part, where and how), nothing it avoids, its number of free picks.

checks.title: Every loop passes its check and repeats cleanly
checks.how: node .claude/skills/music/strudel.mjs check ends with 0 problems: harmony locked to the chart, every role playing somewhere, no note ringing past its loop's end, no empty loop, the intensity curve following the plan; it wrote out/music/midi/sections/ with a folder per loop; every planned technique is heard in the notes, and the flow's shape measures as it should.

checks.title: The score holds only the music
checks.how: music/score.strudel.js sets no sounds, effects or gain: notes, velocity and structure only, every part on its role's channel, drums as General MIDI numbers.

checks.title: The loops are a family, not copies
checks.how: Each loop changes something the plan names (a part enters or drops, the rhythm or the voicing moves, the hook is answered) while sharing the kit's tempo, key and sound world; no two loops have the same notes on every channel.

checks.title: The MIDI pack is complete
checks.how: out/music/midi/sections/ has a folder per loop with every part's clip and the loop's -all.mid; CUE-SHEET.md has the tempo, key, channels, loops and the import steps; out/music/midi.zip holds all of it.

checks.title: The sketch plays every part
checks.how: strudel.mjs instruments and audition pass, and strudel.mjs render --stems wrote out/music/score.wav with a stem per channel, none silent.
